items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand organisations are being urged to act quickly after a reported surge in critical security vulnerabilities affecting local networks. Adding to this concern, a global attack campaign is actively exploiting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter — software commonly used to manage IT infrastructure — meaning organisations running this technology should patch it immediately. Separately, AI-powered cybercrime is growing rapidly in scale and sophistication, making attacks harder to detect and easier for criminals to launch.

Ransomware groups are also at record numbers globally, even as overall victim counts remain steady — a reminder that the threat landscape continues to evolve. **Practical tip:** Check with your IT team today that VMware systems and other critical software are fully up to date.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs expose 85 high-impact flaws across Australia and New Zealand organisations.
